text:
jamal: Quick idea — can we standardize a 'handoff handshake' + fixed follow-up cadence for PMs/SREs after postmortems? We keep losing track of 7/30/90 actions. Proposal below.

maria (SRE): +1. basic template pls. also would like owner TTLs, auto reminders, and a way to tag recurring patterns.

jamal: here's a minimal timeline template I sketched:```
Postmortem follow-up timeline (example)
- Day 0 (incident closed): assign remediation owner(s), create tracking issue, set priority and due date
- Day 3: quick verification (owner): is triage/plan started? link PR/issue
- Day 7: remediation status update (IC + owner) — blockers flagged, next steps
- Day 30: QA/regression check, cost/latency impact review, update metrics
- Day 90: final close + preventive controls + retro notes integrated into runbook
Owners: @owner (primary) + @backup (secondary)
Tracking: GH issue prefix: infra/postmortem-<shortid> (labels: severity, pattern:network/db/deploy/regression)
Reminders: automated /remind or bot pings at Day 3 and Day 7 if no progress
Acceptance: clear success criteria on GH issue before final close (tests, config, playbook)
```

tom (Eng): Can we make the "owner" and "due date" required in the postmortem template and block final closure without them? Also +1 on the bot for reminders.

sophia (PM): For comms cadence: initial stakeholder summary within 48h, weekly updates until Day 30, then monthly summary to product leadership until Day 90. Keep updates concise (what changed, risk, next step).

nina (Ops): +1 on tagging. If we maintain a taxonomy (network/db/deploy/regression/third-party), we can run a monthly "pattern review" to detect recurring failure modes. Could be a 30-min sync with SRE + product reps.

leo (infra): I can prototype a small service that:
- consumes postmortem metadata (title, shortid, owner)
- creates GH issue with labels and reminders
- re-checks assignee after 48h and posts in #eng-oncall if unassigned
Need the exact fields we want in the postmortem meta block.

jamal: I'll draft a minimal spec (YAML snippet) and share here. Proposed sync: 15-min on Thursday to align on action items. who's in? @maria @leo @sophia?

maria (SRE): I'm in. Also want to propose a small change to IC rotation: move to 2-week blocks instead of 1-week to reduce handoff friction and give ICs time to follow through on remediations.

tom (Eng): 2-week rotation seems reasonable to me — reduces churn and context switching. Keep exceptions for PTO/escapes.

sophia (PM): 2-week + explicit handoff checklist (last-day doc + 24h shadow) would be ideal.

incident-bot: Reminder configured: "Postmortem owner assignment overdue" will be posted in #eng-oncall if GH issue has no assignee after 48 hours.

jamal: Ok final plan from this thread: jamal -> share spec (YAML meta + required fields), leo -> prototype GH issue/bot, maria -> review taxonomy & rotation change, sophia -> comms cadence doc. Target: prototype and docs up for review by Friday. Action items: create GH issue template, implement bot reminders, update oncall rotation doc, and schedule monthly pattern review. :white_check_mark:

leo: I'll open a tracking GH issue and add initial checklist once jamal posts the spec.

maria (SRE): Thanks — if we can get the bot to auto-add severity and pattern labels based on postmortem metadata, that will make the monthly analysis much simpler.

jamal: Great. I'll post the spec in this thread in the next few hours. Thanks all.
